title: Market Metrics That Matter: Derivatives September 2026 Volume Highlights
summary: Cboe Global Markets, a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.
body_markdown:
September was a strong month for Cboe’s Global Derivatives business with a quarterly multi-list Average Daily Volume (ADV) of 15.3 million contracts across its four options exchanges, the second-best multi-list quarter. Cboe’s proprietary index options had a monthly ADV of 6.4 million contracts, the second highest on record.


## U.S. Options


- S&P 500® Index Options (SPX®) quarterly ADV was 4.9 million contracts, the second-best quarter on record.
- SPX zero-days-to-expiry (0DTE) options reached a record quarterly ADV of 3.2 million contracts and record monthly ADV of 3.4 million contracts.
- Russel 2000® Index Options (RUT) had its best month since January 2016, with a monthly ADV of 99,000 contracts.
- RUT had a quarterly ADV of 86,000 contracts, its second-best quarter on record.


## From the Cboe Trading Floor in Chicago


- SPX had 46.9% market share on the floor, the highest market share since May 2026.
- ADV in SPX open outcry trading reached 782,840 contracts, up 21.68% month-over-month.
- Total floor ADV in September was 1.67 million contracts, a 9.1% increase month-over-month.
- Proprietary products represented 66.59% of floor volume.


## News and Insights


- Cboe and S&P Dow Jones Indices signed a 25-year extension of exclusive licensing agreement through 2051.[This extended agreement](https://ir.cboe.com/news/news-details/2026/Cboe-and-SP-Dow-Jones-Indices-Sign-25-Year-Extension-of-Exclusive-Licensing-Agreement-Through-2051/default.aspx) allows Cboe to continue having the exclusive rights to offer trading in its flagship S&P 500 Index (SPX) options.
- At Robinhood’s annual HOOD Summit,[Cboe and Robinhood announced](https://ir.cboe.com/news/news-details/2026/Cboe-and-Robinhood-Announce-Planned-Launch-of-New-KPI-Contracts-Further-Expanding-Prediction-Market-Offerings/default.aspx) the planned launch of new KPI contracts, further expanding Cboe’s prediction market offerings. Cboe plans to initially list contracts for 23 U.S.-listed companies that represent some of the most actively traded U.S. stocks.
